text:
maya: Quick check — planning a kernel+quant rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can owners please ack who will be on deploy, canary window, and rollback owner? I'll drive coordination.

liam: I can own the deploy and monitoring for canary 1.

derek: I'll be standby for rollback and infra checks. ping me in thread when you start.

ana: PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4823 LGTM, tests green. one minor perf comment but OK for canary.

maya: Thanks ana — noted. liam, can you run smoke steps below during canary? paste logs to thread.

liam: copying smoke steps:
```
# smoke checks
curl -sS -X POST https://canary-runtime.redwood/sync -d '{"model":"openlm-3b", "prompt":"hello"}' | jq '.latency, .status'
python infra/bin/check_kv_cache.py --slot test-canary
```
I'll post results.

sofia: I'll watch metrics (p50/p95 token latency, error rate, GPU mem). Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/runtime/canary

kim: FYI I've prepped rollback image tag `runtime-engine:2026-03-16-hotfix` and can trigger: `kubectl set image deployment/runtime runtime=runtime-engine:2026-03-16-hotfix -n runtime-prod` — Derek will confirm.

derek: Confirmed, I have perms and will run rollback if error rate > 1% or p95 > 400ms for >5min.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-18T16:00Z — auto-locks in 15m if no owner ack.

maya: Great. Final checklist: (1) deploy owner: liam, (2) rollback owner: derek, (3) metrics watch: sofia, (4) PR checks: ana, (5) ops notify: kim. Canary window 09:00-09:30 PT. If all ack I'll kick off canary at 09:00.

liam: Ack. I'll start at 09:00 PT and paste smoke outputs.

ana: Ack — will monitor CI and post any regressions.

sofia: Ack — will create alert slack-ping if thresholds hit.

kim: Ack — standing by for rollback.

maya: thanks team. if anything blocks, call it out here and we can delay by 30m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploy initiated by liam at 1893457550 (simulated). Canary pods: runtime-canary-3, runtime-canary-4.

liam: smoke results:
- sync call latency: 72ms
- status: OK
- kv cache check: PASS

sofia: watching metrics — p50 65ms, p95 120ms, errors 0. No anomalies.

derek: no rollback needed. closing loop.

maya: Closing thread — rollout succeeded, will schedule staggered ramp to 50% this afternoon. :tada:
